mapper.sql: select ct.template_id, ct.template_name, ct.template_code, ct.category_id, cc.category_name, ct.template_type, ct.status, ct.version, ct.remark, ct.del_flag, ct.create_by, ct.create_time, ct.update_by, ct.update_time from collect_template ct left join collect_category cc on cc.category_id = ct.category_id
mapper.select: select ct.template_id, ct.template_name, ct.template_code, ct.category_id, cc.category_name, ct.template_type, ct.template_json, ct.status, ct.version, ct.remark, ct.del_flag, ct.create_by, ct.create_time, ct.update_by, ct.update_time from collect_template ct left join collect_category cc on cc.category_id = ct.category_id where ct.template_id = #{templateId} and ct.del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: insert into collect_template (template_id, template_name, template_code, category_id, template_type, template_json, status, version, remark, del_flag, create_by, create_time) values (#{templateId}, #{templateName}, #{templateCode}, #{categoryId}, #{templateType}, #{templateJson}, #{status}, 1, #{remark}, '0', #{createBy}, #{createTime})
mapper.update: update collect_template set del_flag = '2' where template_id = #{templateId}
update collect_template set del_flag = '2' where template_id in #{templateId}
mapper.select: select count(1) from collect_data where template_id in #{templateId} and del_flag = '0' and biz_status != 'draft'
select count(1) from collect_field_mapping where template_id in #{templateId} and del_flag = '0'
